changeSet.author: HealthMesh
changeSet.comment: Add Spanish names to root concepts that are provided by the base dictionary
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO concept_name (concept_id, name, locale, locale_preferred, creator, date_created, concept_name_type, voided, uuid) SELECT c.concept_id, names.es_name, 'es', FALSE, 1, NOW(), names.concept_name_type, FALSE, UUID() FROM concept c JOIN concept_name en_name ON en_name.concept_id = c.concept_id JOIN ( SELECT 'Lab Samples' AS lookup_name, 'Lab Samples' AS es_name, 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' AS concept_name_type UNION ALL SELECT 'Lab Samples', 'Muestras de laboratorio', 'SHORT' UNION ALL SELECT 'Lab Departments', 'Lab Departments', 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' UNION ALL SELECT 'Lab Departments', 'Departamentos de laboratorio', 'SHORT' UNION ALL SELECT 'Specimen Sample Source', 'Specimen Sample Source', 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' UNION ALL SELECT 'Specimen Sample Source', 'Origen de muestra', 'SHORT' UNION ALL SELECT 'Consultation Note', 'Consultation Note', 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' UNION ALL SELECT 'Consultation Note', 'Nota de consulta', 'SHORT' ) names ON names.lookup_name = en_name.name WHERE c.retired = FALSE AND en_name.locale = 'en' AND en_name.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' AND en_name.voided = FALSE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM concept_name existing_name WHERE existing_name.concept_id = c.concept_id AND existing_name.name = names.es_name AND existing_name.locale = 'es' AND ( existing_name.concept_name_type = names.concept_name_type OR (existing_name.concept_name_type IS NULL AND names.concept_name_type IS NULL) ) AND existing_name.voided = FALSE );
